evidence.label: BMW SIB 11 03 17 - N20/N26 Timing-Chain and Oil-Pump Drive-Chain Limited Warranty Extension

after.title: Lower-Engine Whine Requires X3 N20 Timing-Chain Diagnosis
after.description: BMW SIB 11 03 17 identifies F25 X3 xDrive28i N20 vehicles produced from March 2012 through February 2015 and sDrive28i N20 vehicles produced from March 2014 through February 2015. A lower-engine whine that increases with engine speed can be associated with timing-chain or oil-pump-drive-chain wear; the bulletin does not declare every X3 defective.
after.solution: Confirm the exact X3 variant, N20 engine, production date and VIN eligibility, then have a BMW-qualified technician reproduce the noise and follow current BMW diagnosis before replacing anything. The historical seven-year/70,000-mile coverage was a limited warranty extension, not a recall, and is not a current coverage promise. ShowMeTheParts established category-level fitment only, so no commerce link is approved.
symptoms: Whining from the lower engine area
Noise frequency increases with engine speed
